title: OptiCom : A Unified Framework for State-Conditioned Composition in LLM-Driven Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.37221v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed to solve complex scientific and practical problems via iterative optimization. However, dynamically coordinating diverse search mechanisms as candidate quality, failure modes, and resource budgets evolve remains a critical open challenge. Targeted empirical diagnostics reveal that mechanism effectiveness is highly state-dependent. Motivated by this, we analyze how individual decisions drive final outcomes, decomposing the expected terminal improvement under a shared budget into cumulative decision opportunities minus cumulative selection losses. Guided by this opportunity-loss theoretical foundation, we propose OptiCom, a unified framework that represents LLM-driven optimizers within a shared configuration space: C=(A,Q,O,E,M,S), corresponding to artifact, query, operator, evaluation, memory, and strategy. translated_title: OptiCom：LLM驱动优化中状态条件组合的统一框架
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被部署用于通过迭代优化来解决复杂的科学和实际问题。然而，随着候选解质量、失败模式和资源预算的演变，如何动态协调多种搜索机制仍然是一个关键的开放性挑战。针对性的实证诊断表明，各机制的有效性高度依赖于状态。受此启发，我们分析了个体决策如何驱动最终结果，将共享预算下的预期最终改进分解为累计决策机会减去累计选择损失。基于这一“机会-损失”理论基础，我们提出了OptiCom，这是一个在共享配置空间 C=(A,Q,O,E,M,S) 中表示LLM驱动优化器的统一框架，其中各元素分别对应产物、查询、算子、评估、记忆和策略。在该空间内运作的基于LLM的快速优化控制器动态……
tldr: 该论文提出OptiCom框架，基于“机会-损失”理论分解分析，在共享配置空间中统一表示LLM驱动的优化器，并通过LLM优化控制器根据优化过程状态动态组合多种搜索机制，解决了迭代优化中机制协调的关键难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes OptiCom, a unified framework grounded in an opportunity-loss theoretical decomposition that represents LLM-driven optimizers in a shared configuration space and dynamically composes diverse search mechanisms via an LLM-based optimization controller according to the evolving optimization state.
